title: lei_n unwrap_or(i64::MAX) skips replay on bad LEI
description: Using i64::MAX as the fallback for a malformed LEI counter (line 251) is correct and intentional. A malformed value should be treated as 'client is far ahead' so replay is suppressed, consistent with the silent-ignore policy for invalid Last-Event-ID values (the LEI is already validated to 's-\d+' before this point, so the fallback is a defense-in-depth measure). A future contributor should not change this to unwrap_or(0), which would cause spurious replay for any malformed value. The invariant is: if LEI is unreadable, prefer to under-replay rather than over-replay.
